In mathematics, a '''bilinear program''' is a [[nonlinear optimization]] problem whose objective or constraint functions are [[bilinear form|bilinear]]. An example is the  [[pooling problem]].

* [https://glossary.cs.uwlax.edu/wiki/Bilinear_program Bilinear program] at the Mathematical Programming Glossary.
